toolchain: Static Qt 6.11.2 / MinGW-w64 GCC 16.2.0 / Windows 11 x64
external_requests: Tests serve their own loopback HTTP fixture and use no provider credentials.

reproduced_and_fixed.defect: Callback accesses a partly destroyed QWidget during asynchronous browser creation
reproduced_and_fixed.reproduction: Show and immediately delete multiple BrowserWidgets, allowing queued native callbacks between iterations.
reproduced_and_fixed.before: Process crashed with 0xC000041D. GDB stopped on SIGSEGV in QLabel::setText from BrowserWidget::reportError in the controller-completion callback.
reproduced_and_fixed.cause: QPointer becomes null in QObject destruction, after derived BrowserWidget state and QWidget children can already be destroyed. Native message dispatch can run in that interval.
reproduced_and_fixed.fix: Each callback checks a separate weak lifetime token invalidated at the start of BrowserWidget destruction. Late controller completion closes its returned controller without touching the widget.

reproduced_and_fixed.defect: The browser viewport does not reflect a resize of a hidden/native Qt host
reproduced_and_fixed.before: resizeAndScreenshot failed because innerWidth did not increase after the widget resized.
reproduced_and_fixed.cause: Reading HWND client bounds in resizeEvent can observe stale/native-hidden geometry.
reproduced_and_fixed.fix: Compute physical browser bounds from Qt's new logical widget size and devicePixelRatioF.

additional_regression_guards: A readyChanged receiver may navigate without the initial pending URL subsequently overwriting its choice.
Older canceled navigation completions do not incorrectly clear loading for a later navigation.
Screenshot-before-ready emits an error instead of silently failing.
Failed loopback navigation recovers on the next page.
Two simultaneous browser views keep independent page DOMs.
CDP success, unknown methods, and malformed parameters are reported separately.
Popup navigation remains inside the preview widget.
limits: This suite verifies the listed browser/component behavior, not full Stagewise feature parity.
Only Windows x64 with the installed WebView2 Runtime was exercised.
The Qt application and MinGW C++ runtimes are statically linked; the WebView2 loader and browser runtime are external dependencies.
No live AI provider, authentication, or credential behavior is covered by these browser tests.
